pool.b.fans_ticketpreise_gruss: Dear coach, we are writing to you on behalf of the terraces.
Coach, this is the spokesman of the fan council, and we have a concern.
pool.b.fans_ticketpreise_lage: Season tickets have become too expensive, and hardly any of us can afford an away trip any more.
More and more people in the terraces hand back their season tickets because tickets and away trips are barely affordable.
pool.b.fans_ticketpreise_lage.hitzig: The prices are outrageous! We pay through the nose for season tickets and away trips!
What is going on with season tickets is a rip-off, and away trips are a bottomless pit!
pool.b.fans_ticketpreise_lage.loyal: We have been here for years and pay gladly, but prices for season tickets and away trips are hardly bearable now.
We are loyal to the club, but many of us reach our limit with season tickets and trips.
pool.b.fans_ticketpreise_lage.ehrgeizig: If this club wants to aim higher it needs a full terrace, but at these season ticket prices it stays empty.
Big goals and expensive tickets do not go together, and you hardly see any of our fans away from home.
pool.b.fans_ticketpreise_lage.wechselfre: If this goes on, many of us will look for another pastime, because the prices for season tickets and trips are inflated.
There are other things to do on a Saturday, and at these prices the first season tickets will stay unsold.
pool.b.fans_ticketpreise_lage.sensibel: It is not easy for us to burden you with this, but ticket and trip prices hit many families hard.
We feel left alone with our worries, because a season ticket and an away trip are hardly possible for some.
pool.b.fans_lob_choreo_gruss: Coach, this is the fan council of the terraces, and this time with good news.
Coach, the terraces are getting in touch, and in the best of moods.
pool.b.fans_lob_choreo_lage: Since the team keeps winning game after game our block is shaking, and we want to celebrate it properly.
The winning run has transformed the stadium, and the terraces have nothing but praise.
pool.b.fans_lob_choreo_lage.hitzig: What the lads are producing is madness! The terraces are on fire and we want everyone to see it!
The run is unbelievable, we go wild every time and want to make even more noise!
pool.b.fans_lob_choreo_lage.loyal: We stood by you in bad times, and now the run makes us all the prouder of the team and the coach.
We are happy for you and the lads that it is going so well, because we have always backed you.
pool.b.fans_lob_choreo_lage.ehrgeizig: The run shows what this club is capable of, and with the terraces behind it even more is possible.
Now that things are going well we want to show that the terraces can carry this team to greater things.
pool.b.fans_lob_choreo_lage.wechselfreud: At last a reason again to come to the stadium every week, and we want to celebrate the team for it.
The run has brought us back, many of us were almost gone.
pool.b.fans_lob_choreo_lage.sensibel: We are honestly moved by what the team gives us in these weeks and would like to say thank you.
The run means more to us than words can say, and we would like to show it.
